name: Vercel
description: A cloud platform for static sites and Frontend workflows that enables developers to host web apps with serverless functions and manage domains, storage, and integrations via REST API and MCP.

evidence.claim: Vercel provides a REST API and a type-safe TypeScript SDK (@vercel/sdk) for interacting with Vercel resources.
Vercel offers an official MCP server available in beta to connect AI tools via Model Context Protocol.
Access is authenticated using Vercel access tokens (Bearer token auth).

notes: Vercel provides both a comprehensive TypeScript SDK (@vercel/sdk) and official Model Context Protocol (MCP) server support, making it extremely ready for AI agent integration.
